subject: Implement Codex resume contract in monitor_delegation
description:
**Blocked on the §5.4/§7.5 spec amendment.** Update `capo/workflows/delegation.py` so that `monitor_delegation` dispatches to a per-agent reader strategy. Codex resume mirrors CC's `--resume <session_id>` if Codex supports it; otherwise apply the S-1 workaround (e.g., re-issue brief with prior context) per the amended §5.4.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Workflow detects `agent` from the `delegations` row and uses the appropriate spawn/resume strategy.
- [ ] Codex resume invocation matches the amended §7.5 exactly.
- [ ] If Codex doesn't support native resume, the workaround is implemented and tested per the amended spec.
- [ ] All restart-resume guarantees from Phase 3 hold for Codex too (no PID re-attach, idempotent notify, etc.).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] If Codex resume workaround can't fully restore session state: completion notification explicitly tells the user what was lost.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: Codex delegation survives Capo restart (anchors §9.4 checkpoint row)
• Integration: workaround behavior (if applicable) tested explicitly

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.4, 5.6, 7.5, 9.4 (after spec amendment)
